parent.goal: Split the config parser into parse and validate modules

acceptanceCriteria.statement: parseConfig returns key/value pairs for valid input
validateConfig rejects duplicate keys with a clear error
formatConfig renders parsed pairs back to text

tasks.title: Extract parser
tasks.goal: Move parsing into src/parse.ts and keep parseConfig behavior

tasks.title: Add validation
tasks.goal: Add validateConfig in src/validate.ts rejecting duplicate keys

tasks.title: Add formatter
tasks.goal: Add formatConfig in src/format.ts using the parser output
